name: W Verbier
positioning: A ski-in/ski-out hotel in the heart of Verbier beside the Médran Gondola, with fireplaces and balconies in every room and indoor and outdoor pools
best_for: Skiers who want direct access to the 4 Vallées from the hotel door
Families or groups who want a two- or three-bedroom W Residence with a kitchen

facts.text: The design fuses local materials such as wood and stone with modern accents.
The spa offers a large, peaceful retreat for relaxation and treatments.
The Mountain Concierge arranges experiences from snowboard lessons to heliskiing, with equipment rentals, ski valet, equipment storage and boot warming.
Brasserie 1519 pairs Alpine authenticity with Mediterranean flair.
The W Living Room has a panoramic terrace, fireplace lounges and resident DJs.
The entrance to Verbier Bike Park is in front of the hotel.
Alpine Golf is an indoor golf experience with a Trackman simulator for play year-round.
The gym has a private yoga room and is open 24 hours a day.
The Médran Gondola is just outside the hotel.

highlights.text: W Verbier is a ski-in/ski-out hotel in the heart of Verbier, with direct access to skiing and hiking terrain across Verbier and the 4 Vallées.
Every room and suite has a fireplace, a Signature W bed and a private balcony.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor WET pools.
The design is inspired by ski tracks in fresh snow and the bike paths around the mountain.
W Residences offer two to three bedrooms with equipped kitchens, spacious living areas and terraces with views.

considerations.text: Sion Airport is the closest airport, about 55 km away.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the exclusive Verbier location.
